data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, **Stripe or Shopify Payments are the best starting points**\. The right choice depends mainly on what platform your store uses, how much customization you need, and your monthly sales volume.

If I were starting a small e-commerce business today, I'd prioritize\:

- Low transaction fees.
- Easy integration with the online store.
- Reliable payouts.
- Fraud and chargeback protection.
- Apple Pay, Google Pay, and other convenient checkout options.
- No expensive monthly commitments.

## Best payment processors for small online stores

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall for flexibility)

- Online card fee: 2.9% + \$0.30
- No standard monthly processing fee.
- Excellent integrations and customization.
- Supports Apple Pay, Google Pay, and international payments.

Best for independent websites and growing online businesses.

[Stripe pricing](https://stripe.com/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Online card fee: 2.9% + \$0.30 on Basic.
- Integrated directly into Shopify.
- No additional third-party transaction fee when used as your sole provider.
- Built-in fraud analysis.

Best if your store already runs on Shopify.

[Shopify pricing](https://www.shopify.com/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![PayPal Community Blog | WebMCP is here: PayPal is helping every merchant become agent-ready](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/m5ug143CLBMTx58QHX87tR0yp_mut01Jfcef-TrwDZlKGOkQj11A-BfIsS68RYX8ZEhrlYF0VdtP2FJxdikuQMj8BdtYX7SkRjN15lCWV9oz8yKGe3bBXL9Y5wfUx2pGPru15kfPn8wgsc8XcjOgFB-OJoWMzvMKUjY252LWdpsT8G6VlvrSqapzfkmpLi6y?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

- Online card fees vary by checkout product.
- PayPal wallet payments are familiar to many shoppers.
- Easy to add to many ecommerce platforms.
- Offers Pay Later and other payment options.

Best as an additional checkout option to give customers more choice.

[PayPal comparison](https://www.nerdwallet.com/business/software/learn/stripe-vs-paypal-vs-square?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Square**

- Online card fee: approximately 3.3% + \$0.30 on its Free plan.
- Free entry-level POS software.
- Inventory and sales management.
- Good online and in-person integration.

Best if you sell both online and at physical markets or retail locations.

[Square comparison](https://www.nerdwallet.com/business/software/learn/stripe-vs-paypal-vs-square?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

| Your situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Shopify store | Shopify Payments |
| Independent website | Stripe |
| Want PayPal checkout | Add PayPal |
| Online and physical sales | Square |
| Higher transaction volume | Compare interchange-plus pricing |
